CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Apollo_Contacts" (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  apollo_contact_id TEXT,
  apollo_account_id TEXT,
  first_name TEXT,
  last_name TEXT,
  title TEXT,
  company_name TEXT,
  company_name_for_emails TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  email_status TEXT,
  primary_email_source TEXT,
  primary_email_verification_source TEXT,
  email_confidence NUMERIC,
  primary_email_catch_all_status TEXT,
  primary_email_last_verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  seniority TEXT,
  departments TEXT,
  sub_departments TEXT,
  contact_owner TEXT,
  work_direct_phone TEXT,
  home_phone TEXT,
  mobile_phone TEXT,
  corporate_phone TEXT,
  other_phone TEXT,
  stage TEXT,
  lists TEXT,
  last_contacted TIMESTAMPTZ,
  account_owner TEXT,
  employees_count INTEGER,
  industry TEXT,
  keywords TEXT,
  person_linkedin_url TEXT,
  website TEXT,
  company_linkedin_url TEXT,
  facebook_url TEXT,
  twitter_url TEXT,
  city TEXT,
  state TEXT,
  country TEXT,
  company_address TEXT,
  company_city TEXT,
  company_state TEXT,
  company_country TEXT,
  company_phone TEXT,
  technologies TEXT,
  annual_revenue NUMERIC,
  total_funding NUMERIC,
  latest_funding TEXT,
  latest_funding_amount NUMERIC,
  last_raised_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  subsidiary_of TEXT,
  email_sent BOOLEAN,
  email_open BOOLEAN,
  email_bounced BOOLEAN,
  replied BOOLEAN,
  demoed BOOLEAN,
  number_of_retail_locations INTEGER,
  secondary_email TEXT,
  secondary_email_source TEXT,
  secondary_email_status TEXT,
  secondary_email_verification_source TEXT,
  tertiary_email TEXT,
  tertiary_email_source TEXT,
  tertiary_email_status TEXT,
  tertiary_email_verification_source TEXT,
  primary_intent_topic TEXT,
  primary_intent_score NUMERIC,
  secondary_intent_topic TEXT,
  secondary_intent_score NUMERIC,
  qualify_contact TEXT,
  raw_payload JSONB,
  source TEXT DEFAULT 'apollo',
  ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS apollo_contacts_uidx_contact_id;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS apollo_contacts_uidx_contact_id
  ON "Apollo_Contacts" (apollo_contact_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS apollo_contacts_idx_email_lower
  ON "Apollo_Contacts" (LOWER(email));

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS apollo_contacts_idx_secondary_email_lower
  ON "Apollo_Contacts" (LOWER(secondary_email));

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS apollo_contacts_idx_ingested_at
  ON "Apollo_Contacts" (ingested_at DESC);

function normalizeKey(s) {
  return String(s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');
}

function pick(obj, aliases) {
  const aliasSet = new Set(aliases.map(normalizeKey));
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (aliasSet.has(normalizeKey(k)) && String(v ?? '').trim() !== '') return v;
  }
  return null;
}

function toNum(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return null;
  const n = Number(String(v).replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ''));
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}
function toInt(v){ const n=toNum(v); return n===null?null:Math.trunc(n); }
function toBool(v){ if(v===null||v===undefined||v==='') return null; const s=String(v).trim().toLowerCase(); if(['true','1','yes','y'].includes(s)) return true; if(['false','0','no','n'].includes(s)) return false; return null; }
function toTs(v){ if(!v) return null; const d=new Date(v); return isNaN(d.getTime())?null:d.toISOString(); }

const r = $json || {};
return [{ json: {
  apollo_contact_id: pick(r,['Apollo Contact Id','apollo_contact_id','apolloContactId']),
  apollo_account_id: pick(r,['Apollo Account Id','apollo_account_id','apolloAccountId']),
  first_name: pick(r,['First Name','first_name','firstName']),
  last_name: pick(r,['Last Name','last_name','lastName']),
  title: pick(r,['Title','title']),
  company_name: pick(r,['Company Name','company_name','companyName']),
  company_name_for_emails: pick(r,['Company Name for Emails','company_name_for_emails']),
  email: pick(r,['Email','email']),
  email_status: pick(r,['Email Status','email_status']),
  primary_email_source: pick(r,['Primary Email Source','primary_email_source']),
  primary_email_verification_source: pick(r,['Primary Email Verification Source','primary_email_verification_source']),
  email_confidence: toNum(pick(r,['Email Confidence','email_confidence'])),
  primary_email_catch_all_status: pick(r,['Primary Email Catch-all Status','primary_email_catch_all_status']),
  primary_email_last_verified_at: toTs(pick(r,['Primary Email Last Verified At','primary_email_last_verified_at'])),
  seniority: pick(r,['Seniority','seniority']),
  departments: pick(r,['Departments','departments']),
  sub_departments: pick(r,['Sub Departments','sub_departments']),
  contact_owner: pick(r,['Contact Owner','contact_owner']),
  work_direct_phone: pick(r,['Work Direct Phone','work_direct_phone']),
  home_phone: pick(r,['Home Phone','home_phone']),
  mobile_phone: pick(r,['Mobile Phone','mobile_phone']),
  corporate_phone: pick(r,['Corporate Phone','corporate_phone']),
  other_phone: pick(r,['Other Phone','other_phone']),
  stage: pick(r,['Stage','stage']),
  lists: pick(r,['Lists','lists']),
  last_contacted: toTs(pick(r,['Last Contacted','last_contacted'])),
  account_owner: pick(r,['Account Owner','account_owner']),
  employees_count: toInt(pick(r,['# Employees','employees_count','employees'])),
  industry: pick(r,['Industry','industry']),
  keywords: pick(r,['Keywords','keywords']),
  person_linkedin_url: pick(r,['Person Linkedin Url','person_linkedin_url']),
  website: pick(r,['Website','website']),
  company_linkedin_url: pick(r,['Company Linkedin Url','company_linkedin_url']),
  facebook_url: pick(r,['Facebook Url','facebook_url']),
  twitter_url: pick(r,['Twitter Url','twitter_url']),
  city: pick(r,['City','city']), state: pick(r,['State','state']), country: pick(r,['Country','country']),
  company_address: pick(r,['Company Address','company_address']), company_city: pick(r,['Company City','company_city']),
  company_state: pick(r,['Company State','company_state']), company_country: pick(r,['Company Country','company_country']),
  company_phone: pick(r,['Company Phone','company_phone']), technologies: pick(r,['Technologies','technologies']),
  annual_revenue: toNum(pick(r,['Annual Revenue','annual_revenue'])), total_funding: toNum(pick(r,['Total Funding','total_funding'])),
  latest_funding: pick(r,['Latest Funding','latest_funding']), latest_funding_amount: toNum(pick(r,['Latest Funding Amount','latest_funding_amount'])),
  last_raised_at: toTs(pick(r,['Last Raised At','last_raised_at'])), subsidiary_of: pick(r,['Subsidiary of','subsidiary_of']),
  email_sent: toBool(pick(r,['Email Sent','email_sent'])), email_open: toBool(pick(r,['Email Open','email_open'])),
  email_bounced: toBool(pick(r,['Email Bounced','email_bounced'])), replied: toBool(pick(r,['Replied','replied'])), demoed: toBool(pick(r,['Demoed','demoed'])),
  number_of_retail_locations: toInt(pick(r,['Number of Retail Locations','number_of_retail_locations'])),
  secondary_email: pick(r,['Secondary Email','secondary_email']), secondary_email_source: pick(r,['Secondary Email Source','secondary_email_source']),
  secondary_email_status: pick(r,['Secondary Email Status','secondary_email_status']), secondary_email_verification_source: pick(r,['Secondary Email Verification Source','secondary_email_verification_source']),
  tertiary_email: pick(r,['Tertiary Email','tertiary_email']), tertiary_email_source: pick(r,['Tertiary Email Source','tertiary_email_source']),
  tertiary_email_status: pick(r,['Tertiary Email Status','tertiary_email_status']), tertiary_email_verification_source: pick(r,['Tertiary Email Verification Source','tertiary_email_verification_source']),
  primary_intent_topic: pick(r,['Primary Intent Topic','primary_intent_topic']), primary_intent_score: toNum(pick(r,['Primary Intent Score','primary_intent_score'])),
  secondary_intent_topic: pick(r,['Secondary Intent Topic','secondary_intent_topic']), secondary_intent_score: toNum(pick(r,['Secondary Intent Score','secondary_intent_score'])),
  qualify_contact: pick(r,['Qualify Contact','qualify_contact']),
  source: pick(r,['source']) || 'apollo_sheet_import',
  raw_payload: r.raw_payload || r,
} }];
